# TreeTech

TreeTech is a small web studio for trades and workshops (electricians, plumbers, heating engineers, roofers, painters, tilers and car workshops) in Vienna and Lower Austria. We build the website before the customer says yes: the preview is free, the site goes live in 7 days, the copy is included.

## Key facts

- Region: Vienna (Wien) and Lower Austria (Niederösterreich)
- Free website preview within 3 working days, pay only if you like it
- Website Start: fixed price from 990 EUR, up to 5 pages, copy included, live in 7 days
- Care plan from 39 EUR per month: hosting, small changes via WhatsApp, monthly report
- Every site includes call and WhatsApp buttons, inquiry with photo, Google Business Profile setup, legal notice and privacy policy
- Languages: German, English, Russian
